provenance_note: All 1834 counted checks are recomputed by the reference; the 29 catalogue spot checks of 2026-08-12 are recorded, not re-derived, and are kept uncounted.
reference: Independent python re-implementation written by a second agent from a method specification, the data file and the page constants only, without access to the page code: record schema, referential closure, registry filters and search, facet selection with exclusion and lift rules, scenario key conditions, matrix counts, permalink encoding and restore, and language outputs, evaluated on the stored step list of every case. Every case input is stored in benchmarks/normenwijzer.reference.json. The 29 catalogue spot checks of 2026-08-12 are carried in the artifact as recorded evidence and are not counted as cases.

tolerance.en: Exact equality with no tolerance: ordered lists in order, sets as stated in the comparison rules, objects by key set, numbers, booleans and null by type.

tolerance.de: Exakte Gleichheit ohne Toleranz: geordnete Listen in ihrer Reihenfolge, Mengen wie in den Vergleichsregeln angegeben, Objekte nach Schlüsselmenge, Zahlen, boolesche Werte und null nach Typ.
tolerance.nl: Exacte gelijkheid zonder tolerantie: geordende lijsten in volgorde, verzamelingen zoals vastgelegd in de vergelijkingsregels, objecten op sleutelverzameling, getallen, booleans en null op type.
tolerance.fr: Égalité exacte sans tolérance : listes ordonnées dans l'ordre, ensembles comme indiqué dans les règles de comparaison, objets par ensemble de clés, nombres, booléens et null par type.
tolerance.es: Igualdad exacta sin tolerancia: listas ordenadas en orden, conjuntos según lo indicado en las reglas de comparación, objetos por conjunto de claves, números, booleanos y null por tipo.
tolerance.pl: Dokładna równość bez tolerancji: listy uporządkowane z zachowaniem kolejności, zbiory zgodnie z regułami porównania, obiekty według zbioru kluczy, liczby, wartości logiczne i null według typu.

tolerance_detail.general: Exact JSON equality after the rules below; numbers compared as numbers, booleans as booleans, null as null.
tolerance_detail.objects: Compared as maps (key order irrelevant); the key set must match exactly (e.g. domain_rows, set_aside_groups, facet_cards, cells, flags, echoed, per_document).
tolerance_detail.ordered_lists: Compared in order: shown_ids, restored_shown_ids, group_heads, selected_ids, restored_selected_ids, domain_rows values (CATS order), per_document values (display order), kc_shown, areas (pairs in scenario order), category_options, scenario_option_order, task_state.req (FACETS option order), restored_state.task.req / state_after.task.req / link_payload.task.req (stored order), link_payload.lift (insertion order).
tolerance_detail.sorted_lists: Already sorted by UTF-16 code-unit order; compared in order: violations, dangling_doc_refs, dangling_scen_refs, prov_without_doc_or_scen, *_without_record, clickable_cells, set_aside_ids, restored_set_aside_ids, set_aside_groups.*.subjects/docs, card_marks_excluded, card_marks_lifted, lifted_subjects, echoed.*, restored_state.lift, state_after.lift.
tolerance_detail.strings: Exact code-point equality (title, filter_labels, first_card_heading with ' — ' separator, message, mark letters, html_lang, page_lang, link_lang).
tolerance_detail.link_payload: The decoded JSON object, compared as an object with the ordered fields noted above; the D/J tag and the encoded bytes are not graded.
tolerance_detail.filter_state: Object {sec, cat, dom, geo, q}; q exactly as typed, whitespace included.

process: Phase 1: a driver agent wrote the stored case inputs, the method specification and the page driver, and wrote no expected values. Phase 2: a second agent wrote the reference from the case inputs and the specification only, without access to the page code. Phase 3: the page outputs were graded against the reference with the reference tolerances unchanged; disputed points were adjudicated against the specification and every correction is recorded in the reference file.

reference_decisions.decision: Each value is checked: single facets must be an option string of that facet; req must be a list whose elements are req options not already kept (first occurrence wins, so a repeat is dropped); lift must be a list of SUBJ subjects (a repeat of a kept subject is merged silently and not listed); sec/cat/dom/geo must be in AREAS/CATS/DOMS/GEOS; q must be a string; scen must be a known id; lang must be in LANGS. A missing field, a field equal to "" and an empty list are never dropped; inside req and lift every element is checked on its own, so an element "" (or any non-option) is dropped and listed with its text ("task.req=", "lift="); null and numbers are dropped, written as JSON text (null, 7, 3).
reference_decisions.why: method.md 8 as revised (element rules stated explicitly in the follow-up revision; case pl.v11).

reference_decisions.decision: partial_link_notice = at least one dropped value; dropped_values ordered lang, scen, task.<facet> in FKEYS order (proc, cont, req, ex, hygr, env; req elements in payload order), lift in payload order, filt sec, cat, dom, geo, q. On a failed decode (bad_link_notice) the partial notice is false and dropped_values [].
reference_decisions.why: method.md 8 'Partial-read notice'; a payload that cannot be read has no values to check.

reference_decisions.ambiguity: 10.2 / 10.11 (resolved, R4) URL language versus payload language
reference_decisions.decision: An explicit lang= (first two letters, lower-cased, in LANGS; e.g. DE-at -> de) wins. Without one (absent or lang=xx) the payload lang applies if in LANGS, else the browser language en. A payload lang not in LANGS is dropped and listed even when an explicit URL language makes it irrelevant.
reference_decisions.why: method.md 4, 8 and 10.11.

reference_decisions.decision: dirty = scenario chosen and some facet differs from its preset (req as a set, others by value); recomputed after every chip click and after a permalink restore (the payload's dirty is ignored). modified = scen non-empty and at least one card edited; the script checks that this equals dirty in every case (it does).
reference_decisions.why: method.md 4 chip, 6 and 8.

reference_decisions.ambiguity: 10.4 Ground of a subject excluded by two facets
reference_decisions.decision: Walk FACETS in table order and each facet's options in table order; the last chosen option that lists the subject as not expected is the ground. With the current FACETS table the not-expected lists of c_none, x_none, g_none and e_build/e_conf are pairwise disjoint and env is single-valued, so no subject can have two grounds and the rule changes no graded output.
reference_decisions.why: method.md 5.4 [code]; the singular 'the ground' is respected by choosing exactly one.

reference_decisions.decision: jump, godom and matrix_cell replace all five filters (named ones set, the rest cleared, geo and q included). godom acts only if the subject-field row exists in the task result (message 'result', verdict(d)=+1, a selected entry carries d); a zero matrix cell does nothing.
reference_decisions.why: method.md 4; a button or cell that is not rendered as clickable cannot be clicked.

reference_decisions.decision: Haystack = fold(join(' ', [id, idn or '', title(L, fallback en), title(en), T(org) in L, i18n.en[org]])). Descriptions, areas, geography and key conditions are not searched.
reference_decisions.why: The record equation 'id + number + title + issuing body' plus 7.1.

reference_decisions.decision: Candidates t, t[:-1] if len>=4, t[:-2] if len>=6 (UTF-16 length after folding); a candidate needs length >= 2; substring match; tokens ANDed.
reference_decisions.why: method.md 7.1.

reference_decisions.decision: Sort SCEN by scn[L][id].n (fallback en) with UTF-16 code-unit comparison, stable for ties.
reference_decisions.why: method.md 7.4.

reference_decisions.decision: lift is an insertion-ordered set emptied only by load, scenario select, scen_restore and task_clear; a lifted subject not in the current N has no effect and is not listed.
reference_decisions.why: method.md 5.4 and 4.

reference_decisions.decision: Kept, one per occurrence, then sorted.

reference_decisions.decision: drop_docs removes those records; append_copy_of appends a deep copy (same id) at the end of docs. Every output of the case (counts, register, self-check) uses the transformed docs; titles/desc are unchanged. A duplicated record is a separate register entry, so corpus.v10_dup renders 72 cards; v5 is false there, v10 true (72 = 72). A permalink round-trip reloads with the same served data.
reference_decisions.why: method.md 4 'nothing else changes' and 9 v10 'number of document records the data holds'.

reference_decisions.ambiguity: Flags graded without an input.checks list (corpus.v10_*)
reference_decisions.decision: The flag set is taken from the graded description 'object {v5, v6, v10: ...}'.
reference_decisions.why: Those cases carry no checks list.

reference_decisions.ambiguity: Field presence ('missing') for null values in records
reference_decisions.decision: A record field is present when its key exists and its value is not JSON null; enum/empty/type rules run only on present fields.
reference_decisions.why: Avoids reporting one absence under two rule names; the corpus has no nulls.

reference_decisions.ambiguity: Granularity of ptx.<L>|claim, v|unknown_key and set.req|enum
reference_decisions.decision: claim: one per (record, language); v|unknown_key and set.req|enum: one per bad element.
reference_decisions.why: The field column of claim is 'ptx.<L>'; per-element counting follows '(one per bad element)' of the neighbouring rows.

recorded.method: Each entry below was looked up on the issuing body's own catalogue page (ISO, IEC, ECSS, IAEA, NASA Technical Standards, HSE, EUR-Lex) on 2026-08-12 and the designation, title, issuing body and publication status were read off that page. The tool deliberately names documents without an edition year and states so in its own limitations, so what is graded is whether the designation itself is a live designation at the issuing body and whether the number, title and body agree. Where the issuing body's page could not be reached or did not state a status, the entry is recorded as unverified and is flagged rather than graded.
